entities.name: Neth'arna
entities.description: Anaba shaman of the Koskun Mountains on Ulgrotha, a minotaur ritual specialist who performed Thexar's scarring ritual.

entities.name: Thexar
entities.description: Clan member whose scarring ritual went wrong and who died.

entities.name: Anaba
entities.description: Minotaur clan of the Koskun Mountains.

events.summary: The scarring ritual meant to mark Thexar's adulthood goes tragically wrong, threatening his life.
events.quote: put her in a difficult position when the ritual went tragically wrong.

events.summary: Neth'arna declares Thexar's death imminent; he pleads for death and accuses her.
events.quote: Her practical and somber declaration of Thexar's impending death

events.summary: Arras reproaches Neth'arna, who listens without defense.
events.quote: She listened to his reproach without defense, acknowledging her part in the tragedy.

events.summary: The clan responds ritually to Thexar's death and Neth'arna resumes her duties.
events.quote: She resumed her work with the clan

relations.quote: Neth'arna was one of the Anaba shamans of the Koskun Mountains in Ulgrotha
